hero.caption: Buildings on the western side of Mill Street at the Franklin Street intersection in Maeystown, Illinois, United States.  The nearer building is Zeitinger's Mill, built in 1859.  Virtually the entire community is part of the Maeystown Historic District, a historic district that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
